title: unified-rollouts: probing/staged-shadow autorollback enhancements
author: Jia Chen
release_notes: Improve staged-shadow probing and auto-rollback stability: add dynamic probe scheduling, multi-metric thresholds, safety guards, and e2e tests.
description: Motivation: Staged shadow rollouts have been susceptible to noisy probes and intermittent false-positive regressions that triggered unnecessary rollbacks. This PR hardens the probing and auto-rollback system by introducing a probe scheduler, multi-metric rollback evaluation, and safety guards to reduce flakiness while preserving fast failure detection. Changes include: 1) probing scheduler with adaptive backoff and jitter to avoid synchronized probes across replicas; 2) multi-metric evaluator that combines latency p50/p95, error rate, and semantic-quality delta into a weighted score with configurable thresholds; 3) safety guards including minimum sample window, progressive escalation (probe -> stage -> full Canary) and cooldown windows to prevent immediate repeated rollbacks; 4) e2e tests that simulate staged shadow traffic and fault injections; 5) observability: new metrics and traces to surface probe outcomes and rollback reasons; 6) docs and runbook updates for ops. Testing: unit + integration + e2e were run; one flaky e2e was stabilized by increasing sample window and adding deterministic seeding to the probe harness (details in commits). Rollout plan: merge to main, deploy to staging with rollout policy staged-shadow-probe-enabled=false, enable feature flag for 10% of clusters for 48h, monitor new metrics (rollout.probe.score, rollout.automatic_rollbacks) and rollback manually if regression seen. Related: ENG-4021 (probe scheduler), ENG-4090 (rollback evaluator).
